messages:
mira: Hey — saw a short 502 spike on /v1/generate ~10:22 UTC. Can someone point me to the dashboards and a quick way to pull sample traces/logs? I want to grab a few examples before we close the incident. :eyes:

alex: For dashboards start with Grafana -> 'API Ingress / Errors' (pods + route breakdown). Direct panel names: 'http.code.502 by route', 'ingress.latency P50/P95', and 'route-error-rate 1m/5m'. Link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/ingress/errors (needs SSO)

alex: Metric names we usually query: `ingress.http.response_count{code="502",route="/v1/generate"}` and `ingress.http.error_rate{route="/v1/generate"}`. For DB-style queries in grafana use PromQL: `sum(rate(http_response_total{code="502",route="/v1/generate"}[1m])) by (instance)`

julian: For logs: Kibana saved search 'ingress-502-samples' — or run this quick filter in logs: `service:ingress AND http.status_code:502 AND request.path:"/v1/generate"` then sort by @timestamp desc.

ops-tim: If you want traces, use trace-tool or the traces UI: https://traces.redwood.internal/ and search for `http.status_code:502 AND resource.name:/v1/generate` — or CLI: `infractl traces query --service=ingress --filter "http.status_code:502 AND request.path:/v1/generate" --since 15m --limit 25`

alex: Also look for the x-request-id header on the logs (we surface it as `request_id`). If you have a sample request id you can jump directly from logs -> traces. Example curl we use to reproduce headers: 

```\ncurl -v 'https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  -H 'X-Request-ID: my-debug-123' \
  -d '{"input":"test"}'\n```

mira: Nice, thanks. For alerts — any quick tuning suggestions? We got paged for a ~3min blip that resolved itself.

alex: If it's short blips, switch the alert to evaluate over 5m with a 3/5 alerting windows (e.g., `sum(rate(http_response_total{code=~"5.."}[1m])) > THRESHOLD` evaluated for 3 consecutive 1m intervals). Or add a debounce in OpsGenie of 3m. Also consider per-route threshold rather than global.

julian: Another option: create a 'high-noise' suppression policy tied to deploy windows or known background job runs. We saw noise when batch-uploads hit the gateway.

ops-tim: If you want immediate evidence collection, run `infractl traces download --filter "http.status_code:502" --since 30m --out /tmp/traces` and attach a few traces to the ticket. I can backfill one in the incident if you drop the IDs here. :thumbsup:

mira: Dropping two request_ids I found: my-debug-123, rb-2026-04-09-77. Can someone grab traces and pin links?

sre-bot: Incident collection started for request_ids [my-debug-123, rb-2026-04-09-77] — artifacts will be posted to the incident channel in ~2m.

alex: Added runbook link: https://confluence.redwood.internal/display/ENG/502-triage-playbook — it has quick query snippets and a checklist to attach traces/logs to incidents.

mira: Perfect. If someone can paste the trace links once available I'll pin them to the ticket. Thanks all :)

julian: Ping me if you want a quick alert PR — I can cook up the 5m/3-window rule and a per-route override.

mira: Will do, thanks again.
